# @dsh-external/dsh-compaction-current-model

DSH host bundle that fixes a manual-compaction model-selection bug for
DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7`

SH host bundle that fixes a manual-compaction model-selection bug for
DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7`:

- Before the fix, `/compact`（手动压缩）summarization could use the session's
last routed model even after

the frontend model picker changed.
- This plugin tracks the durable manual-compaction span
(`compac

tion/start` with `turn: null`) and rewrites the summarization
`llm/stream` to `agentDefaultModel.cur

rentSelection()` — the model the
frontend currently shows.

Automatic compaction, ordinary chat requests, and frozen LLM requests are
never rewritten.

tream` request shape, or `agentDefaultModel`, review this plugin before
